usageNotes: Use this to update an existing Proxmox user's profile fields — display name, email, group memberships, expiration, or enable/disable status. The caller must hold `User.Modify` on the user or on all groups listed in the `groups` param; changing group membership requires the `groups_param` check to pass as well. This call is synchronous and returns null on success — no UPID is issued.

examples.summary: Disable a departing employee account and clear their group memberships

tips: The `groups` param replaces the user's group list entirely unless `append` is set to true — omitting `groups` leaves existing memberships untouched.
Set `expire` to a Unix epoch timestamp (e.g. 1751155200) to auto-expire an account on a future date; set to 0 to remove an existing expiry.
The `keys` field is for legacy YubiKey OTP tokens, not TOTP/WebAuthn — most modern MFA is managed separately via /access/users/{userid}/tfa.
Realm-synced users (e.g. LDAP/AD via `@ldap` or `@ad` realms) may have some fields overwritten on the next sync — local overrides do not persist for synced attributes.
